subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XY123, Departure: 15th August 2022, 10:00 AM, Arrival: 15th August 2022, 2:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency
